segments.name: Medical technology
segments.description: Develops and commercializes the Genio system, a neurostimulation therapy for moderate to severe Obstructive Sleep Apnea.
segments.evidence: Our lead solution is the Genio system, a CE-Marked and FDA approved, patient-centric next generation hypoglossal neurostimulation, or HGNS, therapy for the treatment of moderate to severe OSA, implanted via a single-incision procedure.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and medical institutions pay the company for sales of the Genio system.
revenueModel.evidence: We started generating revenue from the sale of the Genio system in Europe in July 2020.
